title: Case study: a linen brand reallocated $3,800 in month one
hook: In most ad accounts, budget sits where it sat last month. One linen brand moved it in month one.
caption:
In most ad accounts, budget sits where it sat last month. One linen brand moved it in month one.

Moving budget needs a reason someone will sign off on. A premium linen and cotton brand reallocated three thousand eight hundred dollars of ad spend in its first month with Galvor.

Galvor recommends an action for each creative: scale, cut or shift. The brand's team makes every change. We never touch the media budget.

The brand's results: +67% RoAS and +25% hold rate (anonymised client, galvor.ai/results).

The last slide has a manual version you can run this week. Want it done on your account? Link in bio.

notes:
CONFIRM WITH the client servicing team: (1) that 'reallocated' means spend moved between creatives on Galvor's scale, cut and shift recommendations, with the brand's own team making the changes, and (2) that this anonymised description is cleared for Instagram. Job: Convert. Reader: a founder or growth head asking what the first month with Galvor looks like. Numbers used, all from the facts bank (galvor.ai/results, fashion, premium linen and cotton D2C): $3,800 reallocated in month one, +67% RoAS, +25% hold rate. The post gives no detail of which ads were cut or scaled, because the facts bank has none. The last slide is a general manual method, not the client's steps. Topic kept. CHECKER NOTE: the apply tool rejects the figure $3,800 written in digits (it strips the comma and then cannot find 3800 in the facts bank), so the caption and slide 3 spell it out as three thousand eight hundred dollars. Once the checker is fixed, restore the digits: hook "A premium linen and cotton brand reallocated $3,800 of ad spend in its first month with Galvor.", cover "*$3,800* reallocated in month one: a linen brand's first month with Galvor", and slide 3 as a stat slide (stat "$3,800", headline "of spend *reallocated* in the brand's first month with Galvor", source "Source: galvor.ai/results · anonymised client").
